styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clean modern home-office furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF panels, light grey #F2F2F3 panels, charcoal #2D2D2D text, one teal accent #2CB0A5, with the product's light-oak wood tone #D8B98E appearing only on the product itself; neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy two-line Chinese headlines in 「」, thin teal underline dividers, teal capsule labels, teal circular icon markers, numbered rounded-rectangle callouts and letter-spaced English micro-labels; alternating flat white and light-grey infographic screens plus one soft blue-grey wall home scene with a light marble-vein floor; bright even diffused neutral 5500K light, soft contact shadows on scene shots, flat shadowless light on infographic panels; thin-line charcoal icons inside soft white circles; product shown as a light-oak computer desk with white metal frame and white drawer unit at stable scale, props never covering the product; balanced full compositions where desk and copy share the frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从「办公桌 (2)」详情页长图的 10 张切片提炼。已剥离：一体机电脑的品牌机型与默认壁纸、会员二维码角标、源配色名称与英文填充语（Careful selection 等）、未加载的空白图位（按版面结构重建）。主产品为浅橡木色板+白色钢架+三抽柜的现代家用电脑桌；源文件名/文件夹为「办公桌/家装家具家用品」，以图中实际为准归入家具家纺/书房家具。与库内既有两份桌子模版区分：北欧实木书桌（原木、暖调、tan 强调）与组合办公桌（办公老板桌、灰白+雾霾蓝）——本款为钢木结构家用电脑桌、青绿 #2CB0A5 强调、信息图为白/浅灰面板体系。源参数屏中具体数值（占地 0.24㎡、四种配色名等）一律以 {callout} 占位符重建，未写入模版。
